cases.description: A YAML file with CR line endings holding a block scalar of two lines and a plain scalar over two lines: a lone CR is a YAML line break (b-break), so the block scalar is its lines joined by \n and the plain scalar folds to one line (§5.1).

A YAML file that ends without a line break, in a folded block scalar: the last line of a block scalar keeps its line break only when it has one (b-chomped-last is a line feed or the end of input), so the folded scalar at the end is "y", while the literal scalar before it, whose line ends with a line break, is "x\n". The yaml package (2.9.1) adds a line feed at the end of input.
